title: Disco Apocalypse
description: A chaotic baroque scene features a large reflective disco ball suspended in a dark stormy sky, surrounded by swirling smoke, dramatic blue and gold fabrics, and multiple dynamic human figures in classical poses. At the bottom center, a shattered white starburst radiates outward amid falling debris and flickering candles.
prompt: Baroque surreal painting of a large mirrored disco ball hanging in a dark stormy sky, dramatic blue and golden silk fabrics swirling through the air, multiple dynamic human figures in classical and theatrical poses reaching and dancing around it, shattered white starburst explosion at the bottom center, smoke, falling sparks, lit candles, high contrast lighting, rich textures and dramatic movement
